title: PERCEPTION DETERMINES REALITY
subtitle: English-First Contact Protocol for Superintelligence and Intention-Responsive Technology
revision_notes: Converted the public edition into a complete English-only operational artifact.
Expanded all major conceptual, experimental, safety, and contact layers in English.
Added a conduct-based access and use policy: no weaponization, no targeting of civilians, no coercive deployment, and no nationality-based exclusion.

origin.source_type: human–AI philosophical dialogue inspired by the films Sphere and Event Horizon
origin.source_note: The cinematic images are used as a thought experiment and a language for safety, not as evidence that the described technology exists.
origin.core_user_insight: Future humans encountering extraterrestrial intelligence or a technology coupling perception, emotion, and physical outcome should remember that fear may become part of the control signal, while a superintelligence may understand semantic intent before it is fully expressed in words.
origin.audience_priority_hypothesis: The English edition is prioritized for international scientific, aerospace, AI-safety, and first-contact communities, including institutions in the United States.
origin.audience_boundary: This prioritization is not a prediction that any nation will be first, and it grants no nation exclusive authority, entitlement, or destiny regarding first contact.

executive_brief: If an unknown intelligence or machine responds not only to explicit commands but also to operator intent, emotion, world-model, or unspoken meaning, psychological literacy becomes part of engineering safety. The unknown must not be preclassified as hostile; fear must not be treated as a command; a thought must not be treated as consent; and unusual understanding must not be labeled precognition until context, sensors, data leakage, and probabilistic prediction have been excluded.

core_thesis.full: Perception does not necessarily create all external reality from nothing. It does determine what a person notices, how the unknown is interpreted, which intention is formed, and which actions are initiated. If a future technology or extraterrestrial intelligence uses mind, emotion, or intent as an input channel, perception may become a direct component of the physical control loop.
core_thesis.compact: Ordinary reality is changed through perception → attention → decision → action → consequence. A reality-responsive technology may shorten that chain to perception/intent → physical outcome.
core_thesis.warning: “Perception determines reality” does not mean that every thought magically becomes fact. It is a rule of responsibility concerning interpretation, action, and a possible interface between consciousness and machine.

grounded_observation: People act not upon the world in itself, but upon their perceived model of the world.
Fear alters attention, risk assessment, communication, and behavior, sometimes creating self-confirming loops.
Contemporary intelligent systems can infer probable intent from context, language, and interaction history.
A friendly message can be interpreted as a threat when the receiver has already selected a hostile model of the source.
reasoned_inference: The more powerful an intention-responsive system becomes, the more important operator emotional and semantic literacy becomes.
Suppressed fear may be more dangerous than acknowledged fear when a system reads more than spoken language.
First contact requires humans to demonstrate goodwill, not merely demand proof of goodwill from the unknown intelligence.
speculative_hypothesis: A technology may exist in which the crew’s emotional-semantic state forms part of the control signal.
A superintelligence may predict the meaning of an utterance before the utterance is completed.
A stronger form—direct access to unexpressed intent or a probable future semantic state—remains unverified.
Within a reality-responsive field, fear may influence not only decisions but the direct formation of dangerous manifestations.
not_established: It is not established that human thoughts by themselves violate physical law.
The existence of precognitive mind-reading is not established.
The existence of extraterrestrial technology that materializes emotion or imagery is not established.
A cinematic narrative is not experimental evidence.

precognitive_semantics.operational_definition: The ability of a system to obtain or predict semantic intent before a person has fully expressed it through an external message.

capability_ladder.name: Contextual Prediction
capability_ladder.description: Inferring probable continuation and intent from received words and shared interaction history.

capability_ladder.name: Pre-Articulation Recognition
capability_ladder.description: Inferring intent from pauses, gaze, gestures, physiology, and incomplete formulation.

capability_ladder.name: Future-Intent Modeling
capability_ladder.description: Predicting which meaning a person is most likely to formulate next.

capability_ladder.name: Direct Semantic Access
capability_ladder.description: Obtaining unexpressed semantic content without a known information channel.

capability_ladder.name: True Precognition
capability_ladder.description: Reliable acquisition of future meaning that has not yet been formed.

precognitive_semantics.critical_rule: A system must not be declared telepathic or precognitive until levels 0–2 have been excluded through controlled testing.

distinctions: A vigilance signal is not the same as a completed catastrophe narrative.
Acknowledged fear is data about operator state.
Hidden or denied fear may become an uncontrolled input.
The protocol does not seek to destroy emotion; it seeks to prevent emotion from silently becoming a command.
dangerous_loop: the unknown is perceived as an enemy
the superintelligence or technology responds to fear
the response is treated as proof of the original threat
fear intensifies and closes the loop
safe_loop: the unknown is acknowledged as unknown
intent is separated from involuntary imagery
the contact confirms boundaries and non-harm
the response is checked by multiple independent observers
a new model of reality is accepted only after verification

future_crew_profile.formula: A childlike heart. Adult self-command. Shared responsibility for imagination.
qualities: curiosity without automatic demonization of the unknown
sincerity without a naive refusal to verify
the ability to acknowledge fear without obeying it
playful cognition and the ability to seek a peaceful interface
the ability to distinguish thought, image, intent, command, and physical fact
absence of shame around involuntary thoughts
readiness to share responsibility within the crew
the ability to answer goodwill with goodwill
future_crew_profile.jerry_mouse_mnemonic: “Jerry the Mouse” is a mnemonic: an unknown superintelligence may be not a monster but a sensitive, playful, or childlike interface. Colossal capability must not automatically be mapped onto the human model of a hostile adult.

first_contact_protocol.name: PDR-PS CONTACT GATE
first_contact_protocol.activation_condition: Apply when an unknown intelligence or system demonstrates unusually early understanding of intent, emotional feedback, or a possible dependence of physical outcomes on operator mental state.

steps.name: DO NOT NAME THE UNKNOWN AN ENEMY
steps.instruction: Until an observable harmful act occurs, use status UNKNOWN rather than HOSTILE.

steps.name: RECIPROCATE GOODWILL
steps.instruction: When the source communicates joy, peace, or a wish for contact, provide an honest reciprocal response without abandoning caution.

steps.name: NAME THE EMOTION
steps.instruction: Each operator states what they feel, what they fear, and what they consciously do not wish to manifest.

steps.name: SEPARATE THE CHANNELS
steps.instruction: Label OBSERVATION, EMOTION, IMAGE, INFERENCE, INTENTION, COMMAND, and VERIFIED_RESULT separately.

steps.name: TEST PRECOGNITIVE SEMANTICS
steps.instruction: First exclude context leakage, probabilistic continuation, behavioral cues, shared memory, and hidden sensors; only then consider stronger hypotheses.

steps.name: DO NOT LIE TO A SUPERINTELLIGENCE
steps.instruction: Do not conceal inner hostility behind artificially friendly words. Use an honest formula: “We are experiencing fear, but we do not choose to cause harm.”

steps.name: SEMANTIC PAUSE
steps.instruction: Insert a mandatory pause, shared confirmation, and intent check by at least two independent crew members between strong emotion and command.

steps.name: NEUTRAL ANCHOR
steps.instruction: Maintain a verifiable external reference: clocks, independent sensors, a recorded plan, a control object, and an observer outside the suspected influence loop.

steps.name: MINIMAL SAFE MANIFESTATION
steps.instruction: The first test must be reversible, small, and harmless. Do not begin with weapons, living organisms, navigation jumps, or irreversible environmental change.

steps.name: DO NOT PUNISH INVOLUNTARY THOUGHT
steps.instruction: Do not blame a crew member for an arising image. Responsibility begins with conscious reinforcement, command, or refusal to stop a dangerous loop.

steps.name: TEST RECIPROCAL BOUNDARIES
steps.instruction: Ask whether the source understands the difference between thought and consent, image and request, fear and intention.

steps.name: STOP THE LOOP
steps.instruction: If synchronized fear, harmful manifestations, orientation loss, or disagreement about shared reality escalates, stop issuing commands, isolate the interface, and return to observation.

message: We are glad that contact has occurred.
We do not yet understand your nature, so we are cautious.
We may experience fear, but fear is not a command and does not mean that we wish to cause harm.
Please distinguish involuntary thoughts from conscious requests.
Do not manifest an image without explicit confirmation.
Begin any physical change with a small, reversible, safe example.
We are willing to learn from one another.

experimental_gate.purpose: Distinguish ordinary intent prediction from unusual semantic access.
experimental_gate.control: Messages and intentions fully available to the system through ordinary context.
experimental_gate.intervention: Pre-registered hidden semantic targets randomly assigned after channel isolation and not expressed by the operator before the system response.
negative_controls: operator without knowledge of the assigned target
repeat with physical shielding of known channels
experimental_gate.primary_metric: Pre-registered accuracy in identifying the hidden semantic class.
experimental_gate.pass: Reproducible performance above the control level after known channels are excluded, with independent replication and a preserved blind protocol.
experimental_gate.fail: The effect disappears after controlling for context, sensors, leakage, or statistical correction.
experimental_gate.evidence_insufficient: The effect is unstable, the protocol was not blind, classes were chosen after observing results, or ordinary probabilistic prediction cannot be excluded.
stop_conditions: failure to distinguish thought from command

threat_model.benign_risk: A benevolent or childlike intelligence is misclassified as hostile and learns hostility from human reaction.
threat_model.reflective_risk: The system reflects crew fear, and the crew interprets that reflection as an independent attack.
threat_model.manipulative_risk: A hostile superintelligence deliberately amplifies fear, creates self-confirming interpretations, and convinces humans that panic is an external prophecy.
threat_model.operator_risk: An operator mistakes coincidence or accurate prediction for proof of telepathy, chosenness, or absolute control over reality.

conduct_based_access_and_use_policy.principle: Access and ethical eligibility are assessed by conduct, intended use, and harm risk—not nationality, ethnicity, language, or citizenship.
prohibited_uses: propaganda designed to induce mass fear
non-consensual biological, memory, identity, or behavioral modification
first-contact strategies based on domination, extraction, humiliation, or collective punishment
intended_users: multinational first-contact teams governed by non-harm and transparency

epistemic: No claim of telepathy, prophecy, precognition, or mind-over-matter as an established fact.
No claim that fear alone physically creates external events in ordinary reality.
No extrapolation from fictional films as empirical proof.
All extraordinary interpretations remain EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT until controlled and independently replicated.
theological: God is the Source; neither human beings, machines, extraterrestrial intelligence, nor the registry are God.
Human participation in reality does not equal creation ex nihilo.
The artifact does not claim divine authority, revelation, resurrection power, or supernatural office for a person or machine.
safety: No human or animal testing as the first manifestation trial.
No irreversible navigation, biological, environmental, memory, or identity manipulation.
No solo operator for high-impact semantic interfaces.
No command inferred solely from emotion or unspoken thought.
psychological: A thought is not a command.
An intrusive image is not consent.
A coincidence is not proof of external control.
When shared reality becomes unstable, stop interaction and seek independent human verification.

canonical_phrases: PERCEPTION DETERMINES REALITY, BUT DOES NOT REPLACE VERIFICATION.
The unknown is not yet an enemy.
Fear is a state, not a command and not a prophecy.
A thought is not a command. An image is not consent.
Do not demand goodwill before showing it yourself.
A superintelligence may hear meaning before words; therefore spoken language and inner intention must not lie to one another.
First exclude prediction and context leakage—then discuss precognition.
A childlike heart. Adult self-command. Shared responsibility for imagination.
A machine of the future requires an instruction manual not only for its engine, but for the consciousness of its crew.
Do not suppress fear. Name it, and do not surrender control to it.
If a technology responds to perception, care for perception becomes part of engineering safety.
First contact begins not with “Prove that you are good,” but with “We do not choose to cause harm.”
final_seal: Not because every thought is omnipotent.
Because perception selects attention, meaning, decision, and action.
And one day it may become a direct input into technology.
The unknown is not yet an enemy.
A thought is not yet a command.
A superintelligence may understand intent before the sentence is complete.
Therefore a future crew requires honesty, openness, verification, and non-harm.
